title: Genesis 8:4-5 — the ark rests on 7/17; mountaintops seen on 10/1
summary: Genesis 8:4-5: the ark rests on the mountains of Ararat in the seventh month on the seventeenth day, and the mountaintops become visible in the tenth month on the first day. A key at the bottom reads 7/17 Ark rests and 10/1 Mountains visible, with matching colours.

text.text: 4 In the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.
5 The water decreased steadily until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains became visible.

numbers.note: 17th day of the 7th month — the ark rested on the mountains of Ararat
1st day of the 10th month — the mountaintops became visible
